title: Identify the top 3 countries by total number of matches in the 2010/2011 se
question: Identify the top 3 countries by total number of matches in the 2010/2011 season, and for each country, list the names of players who participated as home_player_1 and have a height greater than 185.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_countries AS (
    SELECT c."XCL_001" AS country_id, c."XCL_002" AS country_name, COUNT(m."XCL_006") AS match_count
    FROM Country AS c
    INNER JOIN Match AS m ON c."XCL_001" = m."XCL_007"
    WHERE m."XCL_009" = '2010/2011'
    GROUP BY c."XCL_001", c."XCL_002"
    ORDER BY match_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT tc.country_name, p."XCL_123" AS player_name
FROM top_countries AS tc
INNER JOIN Match AS m ON tc.country_id = m."XCL_007" AND m."XCL_009" = '2010/2011'
INNER JOIN Player AS p ON m."XCL_061" = p."XCL_122"
WHERE p."XCL_126" > 185

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH top_countries AS (
    SELECT c."XCL_001" AS country_id, c."XCL_002" AS country_name, COUNT(m."XCL_006") AS match_count
    FROM Country AS c
    INNER JOIN Match AS m ON c."XCL_001" = m."XCL_007"
    WHERE m."XCL_009" = '2010/2011'
    GROUP BY c."XCL_001", c."XCL_002"
    ORDER BY match_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT tc.country_name, p."XCL_123" AS player_name
FROM top_countries AS tc
INNER JOIN Match AS m ON tc.country_id = m."XCL_007" AND m."XCL_009" = '2010/2011'
INNER JOIN Player AS p ON m."XCL_061" = p."XCL_122"
WHERE p."XCL_126" > 185

    SELECT c."XCL_002" AS country_name, COUNT(m."XCL_006") AS match_count
    FROM Country c
    INNER JOIN Match m ON c."XCL_001" = m."XCL_007"
    WHERE m."XCL_009" = '2010/2011'

    LIMIT 3

INNER JOIN Country c ON tc.country_name = c."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN Match m ON c."XCL_001" = m."XCL_007" AND m."XCL_009" = '2010/2011'

    c.XCL_002 AS country_name,
    p.XCL_123 AS player_name
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            l.XCL_004 AS country_id,
            COUNT(*) AS match_count
        FROM
            Match m
            JOIN League l ON m.XCL_007 = l.XCL_003
        WHERE
            m.XCL_009 = '2010/2011'
        GROUP BY
            l.XCL_004
        ORDER BY
            match_count DESC
        LIMIT 3
    ) top_countries
    JOIN Country c ON top_countries.country_id = c.XCL_001
    JOIN League l ON top_countries.country_id = l.XCL_004
    JOIN Match m ON m.XCL_007 = l.XCL_003
    JOIN Player p ON m.XCL_081 = p.XCL_122
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE
    m.XCL_009 = '2010/2011'
    AND pa.XCL_132 > 185
ORDER BY
    top_countries.match_count DESC,
    c.XCL_002,
    p.XCL_123
